test_the_reason_counts_one_unresolved_an.why: the pin recorded the limitation this branch removes. It asserted that reference_anchor_unresolved appears once per unresolved anchor and stated, in its docstring, that the record does NOT say which anchor -- the count was information and the attribution was missing. The successor asserts the attribution: the set of segments the reasons name equals the set whose allele is unresolved, and the unqualified spelling is gone from the vocabulary. Same records, same 200-record draw, strictly more pinned.
